مَيْطٌ : see 1. ―
-b2- It also signifies Inclination: so in the trad., لَوْ كَانَ عُمَرُ مِيزَانًا مَا كَانَ فِيهِ مَيْطُ شَعْرَةٍ [If 'Omar were a balance, there would not be in it the inclination of a hair]. (TA.) ＝
-A2- Also, A state of mixture, or confusion: mentioned only by IF. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
